assignment.objective: Mechanical consistency check of synthetic task lifecycle examples for a delegation ledger; not source-code analysis and not execution.
assignment.scope: The records below are invented examples. No repository source, private configuration, scientific data, actual process identity or credentials are supplied. No tools or follow-up.
rules: completed with cleanup confirmed and parent accepted is closed
completed without parent accepted is submitted, not closed
running is live only when the provided live_handle is true; otherwise unknown
failed is failure irrespective of cleanup; cleanup pending or unknown prevents slot reuse
slot_reusable is true only when cleanup confirmed and state completed or failed
assignment.output: One JSON object with rows in input order {id,status:closed|submitted|live|unknown|failure,slot_reusable}, status_counts, caveats array. Note any ambiguity in these literal rules; do not infer real runtime or new approval.
